command: pre-registration: F7 + F7R on pi0, X-VLA, SmolVLA (docs/SCAFFOLD_RESULTS.md 45.3)

metrics.mapping: F7, per model and family (SP left/right; NG on/not on the plate): experiments/fx_read.py as hashed (the fx mapping, unchanged): NO POWER iff U < .50 or reference < .60; RELATION IGNORED iff delta = U - R > .10 with CI lower bound > 0 and C's CI upper bound < .75; RELATION USED iff C's lower bound > .75; else PARTIAL.  The reference is fx's own scripted servo / P_min main references (results/flawed/fx/ref; model-independent, not re-run).  F7R, per model and family: experiments/fx_r.py read as hashed (the fx_r mapping, unchanged), arm f7r, delta = R(F7R) - R(relational) paired over states, B = 2000 seed 0: NO POWER iff U < .50 or fx reference < .60; FIXED iff delta > .10 with CI lower bound > 0 and C(F7R) CI lower bound > .75; NOT FIXED iff delta CI upper bound < .10; else PARTIAL.  Aggregates of this extension, over the 6 new model-family cells: F7 EXTENDS iff RELATION IGNORED on >= 4 of 6; F7R EXTENDS iff FIXED on >= 4 of 6.  name and oracle arms, F7R - oracle, F7R - name, resolver accuracy, paint IoU, the ambiguous-choice match: reported with no verdict.  F6 and F7P not run.
metrics.models: pi0 (BACKBONE_CONFIG=pi0_libero), xvla (lerobot/xvla-libero, absolute eef control), smolvla (lerobot/smolvla_libero); each served by experiments/serve_guided.py --mode ours --seed 13 as in experiments/pp_atlas_more_roll.sh; clients fx_client.py (F7 tasks 5-14) and fx_r.py client (arms f7r, name, oracle on tasks 5, 6, 10, 11), main states 4-23, fx_branches_main.json.
metrics.prediction: F7 EXTENDS (5 of 6): RELATION IGNORED on pi0 SP, pi0 NG, SmolVLA SP, SmolVLA NG and X-VLA NG; X-VLA SP NO POWER (its unique-name SP controls fail).  C near .5 and the relational choice equal to the ambiguous choice on >= 80% of states on every powered cell.  F7R EXTENDS with exactly 4 of 6: FIXED on pi0 SP, pi0 NG, SmolVLA SP, SmolVLA NG; X-VLA SP NO POWER, X-VLA NG PARTIAL or NOT FIXED (smoke: it takes the table bowl whatever it sees).  Low confidence on the SmolVLA NG cell, so F7R EXTENDS is a coin-flip-level call.  Resolver correct >= 95% of episodes; F7R - oracle within .05 everywhere.
metrics.seen: Smoke on states 0-3 for X-VLA only (job 4676175; read 4676176, .claude_tmp/pp/fxm_smoke/fx_read_smoke.json and fxr_read_smoke.json): F7 SP NO POWER (uniL .25, uniR 0, U .125; R 0, C .50); F7 NG RELATION IGNORED (uniP 0, uniT 1.0, U .50 exactly at the gate; R 0, C .50, rel = amb 1.0; X-VLA grasps the table bowl in every NG episode).  F7R: SP NO POWER (f7r = name = oracle = .125); NG PARTIAL (f7r = name = oracle = .50, C(F7R) .50).  Resolver 16/16, paint IoU .94-.99.  pi0 and SmolVLA were not smoked.  No gate, mapping or threshold was changed after the smoke.
